in_marathi.name: Bachu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bachu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Bachu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Bhagavat', meaning 'blessed one'. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with Lord Vishnu and Lord Krishna, symbolizing divine grace and protection.
